components.responsibility: Stable public Python package export surface for implemented MIRA core components.
components.why_separate: Keeps import compatibility and package presentation separate from mutable-state, routing, transport, and repository-governance implementations.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral canonical structured-state contract and deterministic synthetic adapter semantics.
components.why_separate: Storage mutation, revision, replay, query, and event semantics are reusable below authority routing and API transport.

components.responsibility: Google Sheets REST persistence gateway and single-writer StructuredStateAdapter implementation for the M2-M0 provider-backed authority path.
components.why_separate: Provider-specific tab/row persistence and credential injection stay behind the provider-neutral STORE-001 contract so Authority Registry and API code remain unaware of spreadsheet identifiers or ranges.

components.responsibility: Persistent one-authority-per-data-class registry, fail-closed runtime bootstrap, and explicit runtime adapter resolution.
components.why_separate: Canonical authority selection and safe restart bootstrap are an integrity boundary independent of storage implementation and client/API transport.

components.responsibility: Same-user API policy, canonical routing, audit, scoped client sessions, pluggable bearer authentication, and bounded HTTP transport.
components.why_separate: Client-facing policy and transport form one service boundary above canonical authority/storage while remaining provider-neutral and deployment-independent.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral managed API composition and startup readiness verification over injected state, authentication, and audit dependencies.
components.why_separate: Deployment composition must verify the existing Authority/API/HTTP graph without embedding provider credentials, resource identifiers, or platform-specific hosting policy into reusable core modules.

components.responsibility: Cloud Run service identity, restart-stable injected bearer authentication, HTTPS proxy adaptation, rate/audit controls, and live Google deployment composition for the bounded M2-M0 proof.
components.why_separate: Cloud-specific identity and hosting behavior must remain outside provider-neutral API/runtime semantics while still being directly tested and fail-closed before live provider writes.

components.responsibility: Public Google Workspace starter bundle integrity for the zero-infrastructure Personal MIRA path, including runtime-only copy binding and direct validation of the bound Apps Script artifact.
components.why_separate: Workspace packaging and browser-first deployment constraints are adapter/distribution concerns and must not leak provider IDs or Google execution behavior into the provider-neutral API and storage core.

components.responsibility: Deterministic source-SHA-bound Personal Google starter blueprint, release manifest and clean spreadsheet snapshot verification.
components.why_separate: Release reproducibility and starter privacy are distribution integrity concerns above the Workspace runtime bundle; they must not make a mutable live Google Sheet or provider identifier into source authority.

components.responsibility: Deterministic single-writer preflight, replay, revision, atomic batch mutation and exact-readback protocol for stock ChatGPT using authenticated native Google Sheets actions.
components.why_separate: The Personal native-connector lane needs a durable integrity contract that matches STORE-001 without turning the model, Apps Script, or Google transport into a second canonical data model.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral one-at-a-time queued command execution with durable replay, stale-revision conflict, crash-before-acknowledgement recovery, and API-001 authorization semantics for the Android-era shared writer boundary.
components.why_separate: Multi-client mutation requires one canonical sequencing seam above Authority/store semantics. Keeping the command sequencer provider-neutral lets Google Workspace or a managed runtime supply execution without making Android depend on spreadsheet rows or Cloud Run details.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral four-question Minimum Useful Setup plus optional resumable progressive discovery for the stock-ChatGPT Personal MIRA front door.
components.why_separate: Onboarding order, answer normalization, post-setup choice, progressive topic state and explicit provider-preference semantics are product-domain behavior above storage and remain independent of Google row coordinates, Android, and service activation implementations.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral durable task identity, actionable next-action state, explicit completion/cancellation/reopen transitions and deterministic active-task ordering.
components.why_separate: Task truth must remain canonical and reusable independently of any one brief renderer, scheduler, provider, or chat session.

components.responsibility: Deterministic twice-daily task-centered Personal Ops Brief slot/run composition, immutable run checkpointing and optional bounded progressive-discovery prompt insertion.
components.why_separate: Brief composition is a user-visible projection over canonical task/onboarding state and must stay distinct from task authority, scheduler delivery, weather/order/calendar integrations and platform notification claims.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral canonical receipt identity, exact money, conservative multi-source evidence reconciliation, explicit correction, and deterministic purchase-history queries.
components.why_separate: Purchase truth must be stable before downstream asset, inventory, order, spending, reimbursement, grocery, or provider-archive side effects are allowed to consume it.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral immutable physical Entity UUID allocation, receipt-linked acquisition provenance, source replay/dedupe, bounded individual-vs-lot quantity semantics and nonidentity enrichment.
components.why_separate: Physical identity must survive receipt corrections and later identifier, fitment, inventory, location, warranty and maintenance projections without those downstream systems becoming a second asset authority.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral namespaced product/device identifier validation, exact-source retention, deterministic normalization, serial-level collision safety and identifier-origin canonical asset lookup.
components.why_separate: Product, model, serial, IMEI, MAC and trade identifiers enrich immutable asset UUIDs but must remain independently queryable/collision-checked without turning barcode strings into physical identity or silently triggering fitment/inventory behavior.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral inventory participation over immutable asset UUIDs plus stable hierarchical locations and independent intended-versus-observed physical location state.
components.why_separate: Inventory/location state must reuse physical identity and answer where an item belongs separately from where it was last observed, while movement events, scanning, broad inventory projection and par/grocery behavior remain downstream services.

components.responsibility: Read-only canonical inventory projection joining tracked asset, identifier, acquisition and intended-versus-observed location truth for bounded no-app queries.
components.why_separate: Inventory query composes existing canonical state and must remain a read-only projection so search, filtering and reporting cannot become a second mutable authority or smuggle in movement/scanning semantics.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral replay-safe explicit inventory observation/movement event history with recovery-safe observed-state projection onto canonical inventory state.
components.why_separate: Movement history mutates only supported observed state through append-only canonical events and must stay separate from read-only inventory query, intended placement, scanner capture, passive reads, container propagation and client UI.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral active shopping/procurement intent, explicit terminal lifecycle and conservative receipt reconciliation without turning purchase evidence into current-intent authority or triggering downstream side effects.
components.why_separate: Shopping intent answers what remains to obtain, while receipts answer what was purchased; keeping them separate lets later grocery, procurement and recommendation features reconcile evidence explicitly without mutating assets, inventory, fitment, orders or finance state.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral read-only reconciliation of explicitly selected active grocery shopping intent against canonical observed inventory within an explicit location scope, with exact matching and honest unknown stock quantity.
components.why_separate: Grocery reconciliation composes shopping and inventory/location authorities but must never become a second shopping list, stock-quantity, par, receipt, recipe or meal-plan authority.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral deterministic current-Resource snapshot, integrity digest, fresh-target restore and independent material-parity verification with explicit coverage limits.
components.why_separate: Backup/restore is nonauthoritative recovery infrastructure above STORE-001. It must preserve canonical current Resource identity/material without becoming a second writable master or falsely claiming Event-history, archive, encryption, scheduling, retention, RPO/RTO or disaster-recovery guarantees.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral durable provider identity and separate appointment-occurrence identity reconciliation from already-normalized evidence, with exact deterministic keys, immutable provenance, explicit ambiguity, and user-confirmed correction precedence.
components.why_separate: Appointment/provider truth must exist before intake extraction, Calendar projection, reminders, outbound contact, or administrative-health composition; keeping this core separate prevents those downstream surfaces from becoming identity authorities or implying medical meaning.

components.responsibility: Provider-neutral finite service intent, recommendation, readiness, suspension, and activation truth over durable structured state.
components.why_separate: Service activation must not be inferred from onboarding answers, recommendations, or provider capability; this state boundary remains reusable before full service composition and provider adapters exist.

components.responsibility: Machine validation and machine-readable projection of canonical feature dependencies, backlog lifecycle state, work-session direction, and production component ownership/evidence coverage.
components.why_separate: Repository integrity gates govern source growth, lifecycle reconciliation and CI evidence rather than participating in mutable product-state authority or runtime provider behavior.
